# Hardik Khanchandani

> Portfolio of Hardik Khanchandani, a Senior React Native Engineer based in
> Bengaluru, India, with 4.5+ years building mobile applications used by
> millions of users. Co-Founder & Founding Product Engineer at Vybout;
> previously Software Engineer (Mobile) at Zepto and Unacademy.

## Sections

- [Experience](https://portfolio-7oqp.vercel.app/#work): Work history — Vybout, Zepto, Unacademy, Mosaic Wellness + Clumio.
- [Skills](https://portfolio-7oqp.vercel.app/#work): Frontend/mobile, languages, backend/BaaS, and tooling.
- [Writing](https://portfolio-7oqp.vercel.app/#writing): Articles, mirrored from Medium.
- [Exploring](https://portfolio-7oqp.vercel.app/#exploring): Photography.
- [Contact](https://portfolio-7oqp.vercel.app/#contact): Email and social links.
